description: NEW-09 (issue #74): the registry-free show-thread stall fallback must keep decode targets AND audio steering advancing while the editor thread is stalled. Imports the 5s tone fixture (150 video frames @30fps + 1kHz audio), plays ~0.3s, then StallEditor 1500 blocks the editor thread (heartbeat goes >50ms stale, DecodeSystem/AudioSystem tickFromSnapshot engage). AssertFrameCached at source frame 40: the playhead reaches ~54 during the stall, so frame 40 is decoded ONLY if the fallback steered targetFrame through the stall — without it the worker parks at ~frame 17 (pre-stall playhead + DECODE_AHEAD) and the assert fails (verified: disabling the fallback fails this assert). AssertAudioWorkerSeekCountAtMost guards the stall-entry seek-storm fix: the fallback handoff must not re-seek the audio worker (each seek is an audible ring-clear); only the initial positioning seek is expected. The asserts drain in the same processQueue pass as StallEditor, before Engine::update re-steers, so they observe stall-era state.
